LUGALANG 1: First year, first quarter Luganda is the first course in a three-quarter sequence. The course emphasizes developing basic communication skills using daily life topics and cultural life in Luganda. Grammatical structures and vocabulary are introduced through interpersonal, interpretive, and presentational modes of communication.
LUGALANG 2: First year, second quarter Luganda is the second course in a three-quarter sequence. The course emphasizes developing basic communication skills using daily life topics and cultural life in Luganda. Grammatical structures and vocabulary are introduced through interpersonal, interpretive, and presentational modes of communication. Continuation of LUGALANG 1.
